Enrollment Definition / Registration
data.description: Condition for being considered enrolled
data.text: "Enrolled" means all participants who sign the informed consent form (ICF), are eligible for the study, and are registered on Day -7 when participants are assigned a participant number.

data.name: SRC Safety Review Before Dose Titration
data.description: Safety Review Committee review required before titration to 30 mg/day
data.text: Before titration to 30 mg/day, the Safety Review Committee (SRC) will review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Safety Concerns Preventing Dose Escalation
data.description: Participants may remain on 15 mg/day if escalation poses undue risk
data.text: Dosing initiated at 15 mg once daily for a minimum of 4 weeks, with an increase to 30 mg after 4 weeks, unless there are safety concerns that, in the opinion of the Investigator(s) and/or Alexion, may place participants at undue risk, in which case participants may remain on the 15 mg/day dose for the duration of the study.

data.name: Zinc Washout Requirement
data.description: Required washout from zinc therapy to prevent confounding
data.text: Participants must be off zinc therapy for a minimum of 21 days prior to Day 1 because zinc works through upregulation of metallothionein in enterocytes resulting in elevation of fecal copper excretion. The inhibitory effect of zinc on intestinal copper absorption is expected to be minimal 21 days after discontinuation of zinc.

data.name: Chelator Discontinuation for Baseline Assessment
data.description: Chelator therapy stopped to allow pretreatment copper baseline measurement
data.text: To assess the copper baseline during the Inpatient Run-in Period, participants will be discontinued from their chelator therapy for approximately 4 days prior to initiating ALXN1840, while maintained on a copper-controlled diet.

data.name: Hepatic Dose Modification Criterion (Bilirubin/ALT)
data.description: Liver injury criterion triggering temporary interruption
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN, indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption of ALXN1840 with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Hematologic Dose Modification Criterion (Neutrophils)
data.description: Neutrophil decline criterion triggering dose reduction
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred, or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD. No further dose increase until resolution of abnormality; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurological Worsening Criterion
data.description: Evidence of neurologic worsening requiring dose decision
data.text: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or by neurologic physical exam assessment: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale must be documented and re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Psychiatric Worsening Criterion
data.description: Clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening requiring dose decision
data.text: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening which may include but is not limited to suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease).

data.name: Rechallenge Conditions
data.description: Conditions permitting rechallenge after dose interruption
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. Rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN, and requires approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor. Participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose. Rechallenge also permitted when hemoglobin and platelets are at baseline concentration.

data.name: Adaptive Design Features
data.description: Adaptive features may be implemented without protocol amendment
data.text: This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol.

data.name: Inpatient Retention Condition
data.description: Condition for remaining in CRU instead of discharge on Day 9
data.text: Participants may be discharged on Day 9 or remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study (at the CRU's discretion).

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Condition
data.description: Condition for extending the Outpatient Period
data.text: To ensure flexibility, the Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval. Participants will be given additional investigational product to support daily dosing; the actual Outpatient Period duration will be recorded and the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Clinically Significant ECG/QTcF Finding Review
data.description: Investigator determination of continuation after clinically significant finding
data.text: If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to, changes from baseline in QTcF) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed.

data.name: Negative Pregnancy Test Requirement
data.description: Eligibility condition for women of childbearing potential
data.text: Women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening.

data.name: Drug/Alcohol Screening Condition at Day -8
data.description: Exclusion based on positive drug or alcohol testing at Screening or Day -8
data.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day -8 (cannabinoids will not be tested); alcohol consumption within 48 hours prior to study intervention administration or positive alcohol breath test at Screening or on Day -8.

data.name: Dietary Compliance Condition
data.description: Willingness to comply with controlled diet throughout study
data.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study are excluded. Copper- and molybdenum-controlled diet initiated after registration/inclusion and maintained throughout inpatient Period 1 (Day -8 to Day 9) and inpatient Period 2 (Day 23 to Day 40).

data.name: Lost to Follow-up Condition
data.description: Criteria for declaring a participant lost to follow-up
data.text: A participant will be considered lost to follow-up if he or she repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and is unable to be contacted by the study site. Before being deemed lost to follow-up, the Investigator must make every effort to regain contact (where possible, 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter to the last known mailing address).

data.name: Screening to Run-in/Enrollment Transition
data.text: Participants eligible for the study (signed ICF, meet all eligibility criteria) will be enrolled on Day -7 and assigned a participant number; CRU admission occurs on Day -8 and a copper- and molybdenum-controlled diet is initiated after registration/inclusion.

data.name: Run-in to Treatment Period 1 Transition
data.text: Following the Run-in Period (diet equilibration Day -7 to Day -5 and baseline copper/molybdenum balance collection Day -4 to Day -1), participants are administered ALXN1840 15 mg/day beginning on Day 1; chelator must be discontinued approximately 4 days prior and zinc for at least 21 days prior to Day 1.

data.name: Inpatient Period 1 to Outpatient Period Transition
data.text: Participants may be discharged from the CRU on Day 9 (after completing the Day 1 to Day 8 intake/output collection and Day 8 laboratory assessments) unless they must remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain study conduct integrity.

data.name: Outpatient Period to Inpatient Period 2 Transition
data.text: Participants who were discharged will be re-admitted on Day 22 or Day 23 (predose) for Treatment Period 2; all procedures will start on Day 23 and participants remain in house until Day 40. If the Outpatient Period is extended up to 14 additional days with Investigator approval, the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Dose Titration from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day
data.text: After a minimum of approximately 4 weeks at 15 mg/day (Day 1 through Day 28) and SRC review of available safety data through Day 23 for each participant, the dose is increased to 30 mg/day on Day 29 through Day 39, unless safety concerns in the opinion of the Investigator and/or Alexion place the participant at undue risk.

data.name: Dose Reduction for Hematologic Abnormality
data.text: Neutrophil decrease > 30% from baseline with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred, or reduce to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution of abnormality, with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Temporary Interruption for Hepatotoxicity
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption of ALXN1840 with weekly repeat testing; rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN with Alexion Medical Monitor approval.

data.name: Dose Modification for Neurological or Psychiatric Worsening
data.text: For evidence of neurologic worsening (AEs or neurologic exam) or clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening (including suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis), the Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose interruption, increase, or decrease based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale must be documented and re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Rechallenge After Dose Interruption
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. Rechallenge may occur when hemoglobin and platelets are at baseline concentration or bilirubin is below ULN; participants previously on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at 15 mg QOD. The Investigator, in consultation with the Medical Monitor, may change dose and dose frequency.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Safety/Protocol Reasons
data.text: Participants must be considered for discontinuation from study intervention if any of the following occur: serious hypersensitivity reaction; severe uncontrolled infection; use of disallowed medication; pregnancy or planned pregnancy; or Alexion or the Investigator deems it necessary for the participant.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Abnormal Liver Function
data.text: Discontinuation of study intervention for abnormal liver function should be considered by the Investigator when a participant meets one of the conditions outlined in the Dose Modification criteria (Section 6.6) or if the Investigator believes that it is in the best interest of the participant.

data.name: Continuation in Study After Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: If the study intervention is definitively discontinued, the participant should remain in the study to be evaluated for safety follow-up, with data collected per the SoA at the time of discontinuation and follow-up.

data.name: End of Treatment to Post-Study Therapy Transition
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods (ie, Day 40), participants will either transition to therapy that was discontinued before enrollment, transition to other standard of care therapy as directed by the treating physician, or, at the discretion of the treating physician, request continuation of ALXN1840 treatment permissible under local regulations for preapproval access. All participants should return to the CRU for the EOS Visit on Day 54 (+/- 2 days).

data.name: Participant Withdrawal From Study
data.text: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request, or may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons. The participant will be permanently discontinued both from the study intervention and from the study at that time.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: A participant is considered to have completed the study if he/she has completed all phases of the study including the last scheduled procedure shown in the Schedule of Activities (ie, the EOS Visit on Day 54 +/- 2 days). The end of the study is defined as the date the last participant completes the last visit shown in the SoA.

data.name: Early Termination / Early Discontinuation Visit
data.description: At the time of discontinuation from the study, if possible, an early discontinuation visit (EOS/ET Visit) should be conducted as shown in the SoA, including a full physical examination. The participant is permanently discontinued from both study intervention and the study.

data.name: Withdrawal by Participant
data.description: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request; the reason must be recorded in source documents and CRF. If consent for disclosure of future information is withdrawn, Alexion may retain and use data collected before withdrawal; the participant may request destruction of untested samples.

data.name: Investigator Withdrawal for Safety/Compliance/Administrative Reasons
data.description: Participant may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons (including likely non-compliance with controlled diet or study procedures).

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: A participant who repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and cannot be contacted (after at least 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter) will be considered to have withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Study or Site Termination by Sponsor
data.description: Alexion reserves the right to close the study site or terminate the study at any time for any reason. Reasons for early closure may include failure of the Investigator to comply with the protocol, IRB/IEC or local health authority requirements, Alexion procedures or GCP guidelines; inadequate recruitment of participants; or discontinuation of further study intervention development. A site is considered closed when all participants have completed the end of study or early discontinuation visit.

data.name: Pregnancy
data.description: Pregnancy or planned pregnancy requires the participant to be considered for discontinuation of study intervention.

data.name: SRC Pre-Titration Safety Review Decision
data.description: Before titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29, the Safety Review Committee reviews available safety data through Day 23 for each participant to determine whether dose escalation may proceed or the participant remains at 15 mg/day.

data.name: Day 9 Discharge Decision
data.description: Decision whether to discharge the participant from the CRU on Day 9 to the Outpatient Period or retain them inpatient for safety or study integrity.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Decision
data.description: Investigator decision to extend the Outpatient Period by up to 14 additional days with provision of additional investigational product; participant resumes Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Day 29 Dose Escalation Decision
data.description: Decision at Day 29 to increase dose from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day, maintain 15 mg/day, or modify dosing based on safety and dose modification criteria.

data.name: Dose Modification / Rechallenge Decision
data.description: Ongoing decision point based on safety laboratory, neurologic, and psychiatric assessments to reduce, interrupt, restrict increases of, or rechallenge with ALXN1840 (maximum 3 rechallenges), with Alexion Medical Monitor consultation.

data.name: Eligibility Confirmation at Enrollment
data.description: Decision at Day -7 registration to enroll the participant and initiate the copper- and molybdenum-controlled diet, contingent on eligibility including zinc washout, negative pregnancy test, negative drug/alcohol screen, and dietary compliance willingness.

data.name: Post-Study Therapy Decision at Day 40
data.description: Treating physician decision at Day 40 to resume pre-enrollment therapy, start other standard of care therapy, or request continued ALXN1840 under preapproval access, prior to the EOS Visit at Day 54 +/- 2 days.
